resources.string: This build of the app has no Firebase settings, so orders can\'t be shared.
Share orders with your masters: each one sees only the orders you assign to him, with the client\'s phone, address and printers, never debts. When he finishes, the order is done here.
Use the company\'s Google account; it owns the shared data.
This phone works for %1$s as a master.
Masters type this code in the app (\"I work for a company\") to join.
%1$s invites you to PrintMaster. In the app choose \"I work for a company\" and enter the code: %2$s
Nobody has joined yet. Send the code to your masters.
Tap a master to say who he is in your list of masters. Orders assigned to him then go to his phone.
He stops seeing the company\'s orders. Orders already on his phone stay there.
Pick him in your list of masters, or add him as a new one.
